### Sentencing Rules
- Sentences must correspond to the charge tier (see [textlink="Crimes & Punishments" link="HLSpaceLawList"] and the [textlink="Sentencing Reference" link="HLSpaceLawList"] table) - Multiple charges are served [bold]consecutively[/bold] unless the HoS grants concurrent sentencing - Sentences may be reduced for cooperation or documented mitigating circumstances - Sentences may be increased for aggravating circumstances or repeat offenses — document the basis for any increase - Sentences may not be increased arbitrarily or punitively; all adjustments must be justifiable
